correctness.rationale: The exact source ODE factors into P(x)[a-A_delta(x)] and (1+u)Q(a)(h-x). S_N strictly decreases, so A_delta strictly increases and all four phase thresholds strictly order. The displayed integral V is nonnegative, continuous on only the selected endpoint faces, and proper relative to every other boundary. The derivative identity splits into three nonpositive terms on every phase, including equalities; the largest invariant zero-derivative set is the selected equilibrium. LaSalle proves the common global limit for all epsilon>0 and interior data. Standard-library checker tests algebraic identity and parameter sweeps, but the proof—not the numerical check—establishes infinite-time and arbitrary-parameter statements.

originality.rationale: Direct comparison of the source paper’s full main sections and Appendix reveals local Jacobian classifications and representative plots, without a uniform global Lyapunov proof, rigorous equality-case coverage or complete sharp ordered incentive thresholds. Structurally related 2022, 2023 and 2024 game models have different payoffs and feedback signs, sometimes admit limit cycles or bistability, and do not imply the same-model theorem. Accessible literature and mathematical-result searches did not disclose a stronger same-model result; absolute novelty cannot be certified by a finite search.
residual_risks: A general dynamical-systems theorem or unindexed treatment may imply some abstract convergence properties, although the four explicit model-dependent thresholds are not present in the inspected sources.

value.rationale: A complete global convergence result is mathematically material: local equilibrium stability and five numerical phase portraits do not exclude other attractors. The integral strict Lyapunov certificate covers all positive timescale ratios, gives a sharp five-regime classification with nonhyperbolic equalities, precludes interior cycles and static hysteresis, and identifies strict monotonicity of the institutional marginal incentive as the exact structural mechanism. This is meaningful for predicting long-run cooperation and avoiding invalid inferences from local stability.
